title: Pilot Automations
help: Pilot Automations does by itself what the team did by hand: giving orders to agents, sending to the depot when stock comes back, sending to dispatch, telling customers at each step, stopping the ads of a sold-out product, sending the evening report, warning when the call queue drags, bringing old customers back. Each automation has its switch in “Automations”. Delivery messages go by WhatsApp first, else by SMS, else they wait in “To send”; replies arrive in Pilot Message.

auto.lead: Pilotix does these tasks by itself. Each switch takes effect at once.

log.title: What Pilotix did
log.empty: Nothing yet: each thing an automation does is written here.

phone.title: This phone
phone.why: The evening report and the alerts arrive as notifications on the phones where you tapped “Turn on notifications”.
phone.testSent: Test sent: look at your phone
phone.testNone: No phone got the test: first tap “Turn on notifications”
phone.denied: Notifications are blocked for Pilotix on this phone. Allow them in the browser settings (the lock next to the address › Notifications), then come back here.
phone.unsupported: This browser can’t get notifications. On iPhone: first add Pilotix to the Home Screen (Share › Add to Home Screen), then open it from there.
phone.ask: Turn on notifications: the evening report and the call queue alerts will ring on this phone, even when Pilotix is closed.
phone.demo: Nothing rings in the preview. On pilotix.online, tap “Turn on notifications” here from your phone.

assign.name: Automatic assignment
assign.then: gives it to an agent, and each parcel to follow to someone in follow-up

pilot.name: Pilot Auto Assign
pilot.then: chooses its delivery company with your rules (else the default company)

queue.name: Slow call queue
queue.when: an order waits without a call, or an agent on line stops calling
queue.then: tells her team manager and the people chosen, once an hour at most
queue.now_one: Right now: {{count}} order has waited more than {{h}} h.
queue.now_other: Right now: {{count}} orders have waited more than {{h}} h.
queue.nowNone: Right now: no order waits too long.
queue.closed: Outside call hours: the queue is not watched now.

evening.name: Evening report
evening.then: sends the day’s numbers to the phone: orders, confirmed, delivered, returns, cash in, ads and profit

nostock.name: Out of stock → stop
nostock.when: a product has no stock left
nostock.then: pauses its ads and shows “sold out” instead of the form on its pages; everything starts again when the stock comes back
nostock.noAds: Pilot Ads is not in your plan: only the pages close.
nostock.nowNone: Every product in an ad or on a page has stock.

stockback.name: Stock is back
stockback.then: sends to the depot the “no stock” orders it can serve, oldest first

dispatch.name: Automatic dispatch
dispatch.when: every item of an order is picked
dispatch.then: sends it to “In dispatch” with its company, its parcel created there
dispatch.offNote_one: {{count}} order waits in “To assign” for a manager to choose.
dispatch.offNote_other: {{count}} orders wait in “To assign” for a manager to choose.
dispatch.offEmpty: Off: each ready order will wait in “To assign” for a manager to choose.

livreur.name: Automatic driver
livreur.then: gives it to the driver with the fewest parcels today, among those who said “I work today” and are under their maximum in hand; he gets a notification
livreur.nobody: No driver has said “I work today” yet: the orders wait in “To assign”.
livreur.allFull: all have their maximum in hand: they go as soon as one delivers
livreur.max: Most parcels in hand per driver
livreur.needsDispatch: Works with “Automatic dispatch”: turn it on too.
livreur.noOwn: No “Private delivery” among your delivery companies.

delivery.name: Delivery messages
delivery.when: an order moves to a new step
delivery.then: tells the customer on WhatsApp, or by SMS

comeback.name: Come-back offer
comeback.when: {{days}} have passed after a delivered order
comeback.then: sends your WhatsApp offer to the customer who accepts offers and has not ordered again
comeback.none: First make a campaign in Marketing › Campaigns: Meta must approve its message.
comeback.noFeature: WhatsApp campaigns are not in your plan.
comeback.paused: This campaign is paused: nothing goes out while it is.

lines.stockbackOff: “Out of stock” turned off — started again: {{ads}}
lines.wait_one: {{count}} order had waited {{hours}} h for a call
lines.wait_other: {{count}} orders had waited {{hours}} h for a call
lines.idle_one: {{agent}} had not called for {{minutes}} min ({{count}} order waited for her)
lines.idle_other: {{agent}} had not called for {{minutes}} min ({{count}} orders waited for her)
lines.comebackProblem: Come-back offer: the campaign “{{campaign}}” is not ready
lines.release_one: {{count}} order without stock sent to the depot
lines.release_other: {{count}} orders without stock sent to the depot

off: Delivery messages are stopped: no message is sent to customers.

when.created: When an order comes in (website, page, form). The customer knows a call is coming and answers more often.
when.confirmed: When the team confirms the order: the product and the total, delivery included.
when.shipped: When the parcel leaves with the delivery company: delay and tracking number.
when.out_for_delivery: The day the courier has it (home delivery): keep the phone on.
when.stopdesk: When the parcel reaches the company’s desk (stop desk): come and collect it.
when.failed: When the courier could not deliver: the customer answers if they still want it.
when.returning: When the order is cancelled at the courier: last chance to save it.
when.delivered: After delivery: thanks, and an open door if anything is wrong.

feed.demoNote: Preview: nothing is really sent. Numbers ending in 3 or 7 “have no WhatsApp”, to show the switch to SMS.
feed.todoBanner_one: {{count}} message is waiting to be sent by hand.
feed.todoBanner_other: {{count}} messages are waiting to be sent by hand.

msg.unicode: Arabic or special characters: shorter SMS

sentVia.manual: To send by hand: no automatic sending available

tpl.CHANGED: Text changed: send it to WhatsApp again

cases.howHelp: Each status change sends at most one message: once per order for “received”, “confirmed”, “shipped”, “cancelled” and “delivered”, at most once a day for the others. A message waiting for the end of the night is replaced if the order moves on meanwhile.
cases.step1Hint: From Pilot Message’s number, with a text approved by WhatsApp.
cases.step2Hint: If the number has no WhatsApp, or the WhatsApp is not received within 1 h.
cases.step3Hint: No SMS sending set up: the message waits in “To send”, one tap to send it.
cases.nightHint: A night message leaves in the morning, unless the order changed meanwhile.
cases.title: The cases and their messages
cases.metaWaiting_one: {{count}} text is not approved by WhatsApp yet: meanwhile it goes by SMS.
cases.metaWaiting_other: {{count}} texts are not approved by WhatsApp yet: meanwhile they go by SMS.
cases.metaAllOk: All active texts are approved by WhatsApp.
cases.submitted_one: {{count}} text sent to WhatsApp for approval
cases.submitted_other: {{count}} texts sent to WhatsApp for approval
cases.nothingToSubmit: Nothing to send: the texts are already at WhatsApp
cases.example: Example with an imaginary order (Amina, PX2041). Each customer gets their own first name, order, total and delivery company.
cases.unicodeWarn: Arabic letters, emoji or ’: each SMS is 2 to 3 times shorter (more expensive)
cases.metaNote: A changed text must be approved again by WhatsApp (“Send the texts to WhatsApp”); meanwhile it goes by SMS.
cases.onTheWay: On the way, when it happens:

tester.title: Test a message
tester.help: Pick a case, and an order reference to see its real values, then send it to your number. Nothing is saved on the order.
tester.demo: Preview: sending is simulated. A number ending in 3 or 7 has no WhatsApp and gets the SMS.

via.none: No sending possible (WhatsApp and SMS off)

tester.adminOnly: Only an administrator can send a test message (each one is billed).

results.title: Results
results.savedHelp: Orders told about a failed delivery or a cancellation, then delivered after all.
results.note: Customers’ WhatsApp answers arrive in Pilot Message, with the message before them. Dellal answers questions and hands over to the team to resend an order or change an address.

settings.enabledHint: Messages leave at each order status change.
settings.whatsappHint: From Pilot Message’s WhatsApp number. Otherwise everything goes by SMS.
settings.langHint: Darija in Latin letters reads like your chats and costs 2 to 3 times less by SMS.
settings.quietHint: A night message leaves at the end of this range (Algeria time). Same hour on both sides: any hour.
settings.waHelp: WhatsApp only allows a business’s first message with an approved text (“Utility” template). Pilotix sends your texts to WhatsApp for approval; it often takes minutes, sometimes 24 h.
settings.waConnect: Connect it in Pilot Message › Settings
settings.wabaHint: Meta Business › WhatsApp accounts, or in WhatsApp Manager. Used to send your texts for approval.
settings.waTemplates: Texts are approved in the “Cases” tab: “Send the texts to WhatsApp”, then “Check approval”.
settings.smsTitle: When the customer has no WhatsApp
settings.smsHelp: About 1 customer in 5 has no WhatsApp on their order’s number. They get the message by SMS.
settings.sms_gatewayHint: Automatic: from a shop phone (SMS Gateway for Android) or an SMS service.
settings.sms_manualHint: The message waits in “To send”: one tap opens WhatsApp or SMS with the text ready.
settings.sms_offHint: WhatsApp only: without WhatsApp, the customer is not told.
settings.android: SMS Gateway for Android (a shop phone)
settings.smsUrlAndroid: https://api.sms-gate.app for the cloud server, or the phone’s address on your network (http://192.168.x.x:8080).
settings.smsUrlHttp: Pilotix POSTs { to: '+213…', text: '…' }, with the token in an Authorization: Bearer header.
settings.secretKept: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.androidHow: Setting up SMS Gateway for Android
androidSteps: Install “SMS Gateway for Android” on a phone with the shop’s SIM (an unlimited SMS plan is cheapest).
In the app, turn on “Cloud server”: it shows a username and a password.
Copy them here, save, then click “Connect SMS reports”: Pilotix will know whether the SMS was received, and customers’ answers will arrive here.
Keep the phone on, charging, with signal.
settings.hookHint: Received, failed, and customers’ SMS answers. Keep it secret.
settings.manualNote: Each message to send appears in Messages › To send, with “Open WhatsApp” and “Open SMS”: the text is already written, just press send.
settings.demo: Preview: sending is simulated, no SMS or WhatsApp leaves.
settings.appSecretMissing: Without the Meta app secret, Pilotix does not accept WhatsApp reports (read, received, not received): a message not received switches to SMS only after 1 h.
settings.appSecretLink: Add it in Pilot Message › Settings
